title: New-category generalisation of R1-ILA (Dice/Doll/Holder candidates)
target_claim: A1 extended: R1-ILA gain is not specific to Bird/Car/Cube; illumination-shift dose-response (E16 hypothesis) reproduces on unseen categories
why_current_insufficient: A1/A2/A3 rest on 3 categories chosen by alphabetical completeness order (not performance, but still only 3); reviewer risk = '3-category coincidence'
data_exists_and_compatible: Official metadata local for all 10 cats; pixels via E8 streaming selective extraction (validated pipeline + hard gate A1-A5); frozen protocol (bank rule / view120 / official labels) unchanged
fair_comparison: F0 vs R1-ILA identical setup: same bank draw rule seed, same view120 test, same 1-NN-max scoring, same official_metrics filter; no history table -> drop E16 reproduction identity check (new script variant)
metrics_statistics: AUROC / AP / d' + illumination diagnostics A-E; 3 seeds; mean delta + per-seed sign consistency + test-image paired bootstrap CI
gpu_estimate: ~4.5 min/cell x 3 seeds x 1-2 cats = 14-28 min (F0+R1+diagnostics; E16 measured 4.4-4.6 min/cell)
disk_estimate: 0.8 GB/cat (l0_448 only) or 2.7 GB/cat (4 cache kinds + masks)
network_cost: ~22 min/cat (14.9-17.6 GB streamed @ ~16 MB/s; E8 measured ~45 min for Car+Cube)
go_criteria: 3/3 seed dAUROC > 0 AND seed-mean >= +0.005; illumination-shift D ordering consistent with gain sign across categories
stop_criteria: seed-mean dAUROC < 0 (with ceiling check vs E13-B2 baseline-dependence)
failure_interpretation: If dAUROC ~ 0 with high frozen baseline -> consistent with baseline/headroom dependence (E13-B2), a boundary condition, not tuning target. If shift large but gain negative -> hypothesis damaged, report as-is. Forbidden: parameter change, seed cherry-picking, label edits
risks: hf-mirror reachability must be re-verified; streaming/gate failure; category choice must be human-approved (do NOT auto-select)

title: 4-view test-set extension on Bird/Car/Cube (zero data acquisition)
expansion_class: C (new test condition / larger evaluation split)
target_claim: A1/A3 robustness bound: conclusions are not an artefact of single view120; cross-view stability of the R1-ILA gain
why_current_insufficient: E19 limitations #5 explicitly lists single-view as a known gap; geometric view change is a standard reviewer request
data_exists_and_compatible: 100% already cached: l0_448 4-view test (Good 800 + NG 2000 per category) + tests split by specimen (no leakage); E8 frozen VIEWS = 090/120/240/330
fair_comparison: same F0/R1-ILA settings; only the test set is widened from view120 to the frozen 4 views; bank/training untouched
metrics_statistics: 4-view pooled AUROC/AP + per-view dAUROC (win count over 4 views) + illumination x view stratification; statistical power: test size ~2700/cat shrinks the bootstrap delta-AUROC noise halfwidth from ~0.017-0.019 to ~0.009 (cf. E20-B: MVtec AD2 single scene 0.04-0.07)
gpu_estimate: ~2.4-4x test extraction/scoring vs view120; pilot 1 seed x 3 cats ~30-40 min; full 3 seeds x 3 cats ~1.5-2 h (needs a precise smoke measurement first)
go_criteria: pooled 4-view seed-mean dAUROC >= 50% of the view120 value AND >= 6/8 category-view cells positive (Bird+Car)
stop_criteria: pooled dAUROC < 0 or systematic view-driven reversal (e.g. only 120 positive)
failure_interpretation: If view120 is special -> report explicitly as a scope limitation; do NOT re-select views to restore the desired sign
risks: larger test inflates runtime; must NOT be framed as new categories

title: Bird full 12-view extension (local originals, zero network)
target_claim: A1/A3 robustness bound at maximum angular coverage (12 turntable views) for the category with the strongest R1-ILA signal
why_current_insufficient: same single-view limitation; 12-view is the strongest available geometric-generalisation probe for one category
data_exists_and_compatible: Bird originals local (12 views x 10 illuminations); new l0_448 cache for the 8 uncovered test views must be generated locally (~5600 images, CPU); protocol unchanged
fair_comparison: same F0/R1-ILA, same bank; test = all 12 views x 10 illuminations
metrics_statistics: 12-view pooled AUROC/AP + per-view dAUROC + illumination breakdown
gpu_estimate: cache build ~30-60 min CPU; GPU test extraction 12x vs view120; 3 seeds x 1 cat ~45-60 min (estimate, needs smoke)
disk_estimate: ~2.2 GB (l0_448 only for newly generated views)
go_criteria: 12-view seed-mean dAUROC same sign as view120 AND >= 9/12 views positive
stop_criteria: sign reversal vs view120 on the majority of views
failure_interpretation: report as category-specific view sensitivity; no view re-selection
risks: Bird-only (not a category expansion); cache generation must use frozen E8 writer code paths
